newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SKF sells FlexLink operations, 800 mln skr gain.
newsitem.headline: SKF sells FlexLink operations, 800 mln skr gain.

text.p: Swedish rollerbearing company SKF and Scandinavian Equity Partners (SEP) said they signed a letter of intent to sell SKF's FlexLink operations to SEP. SKF estimates the transaction will generate a capital gain of 800 million crowns.

FlexLink's main product is a conveyor system for handling lightweight goods. FlexLink Systems had 1996 sales of around 600 million crowns. Earnings totalled about 110 million crowns and the company employs 223 people. -- Simon Haydon, Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700-1004
